problem: Event được quản lý bằng form + email; follow-up bị bỏ quên.
solution: Landing, registration, reminder, check-in, follow-up và CRM sync.
entities: Event, Session, Attendee, Registration, CheckIn, FollowUp
relations: Event -> Session: contains | Attendee -> Registration: completes | Registration -> Session: attends | Attendee -> FollowUp: receives
components: Landing, Registration, Email, Check-in, CRM

name: MCP Hub
tagline: Kho MCP server có phân quyền theo profile và token mã hoá.
problem: Mỗi dự án cấp quyền tool tràn lan; khó kiểm soát scope và audit.
solution: Profile, scope, token encryption, allowlist và audit.
entities: Server, Tool, Profile, Scope, Token, AuditEvent
relations: Profile -> Server: enables | Server -> Tool: exposes | Tool -> Scope: requires | Token -> Profile: scoped to
components: Gateway, Auth, Policy, Token vault, Audit

name: Integration Hub
tagline: Kết nối ERP, CRM, M365 và Shopify với mapping rõ ràng.
problem: Tích hợp point-to-point; mỗi cặp hệ thống lại viết lại connector và xử lý lỗi.
solution: Connector, endpoint, mapping, queue, retry, monitoring và schema registry.
entities: Connector, Endpoint, Mapping, Job, Error, Schema
relations: Connector -> Endpoint: connects | Mapping -> Schema: follows | Job -> Connector: runs | Error -> Job: belongs to
components: Connector, Mapper, Queue, Monitor, Schema registry

name: Low-code Internal Tools
tagline: Form, workflow, permission và deploy cho internal tools.
problem: Internal tools nhỏ nhưng phải chờ dev; business tự làm Excel/chat.
solution: Form builder, workflow, RBAC, data store và publish.
entities: App, Form, Field, Workflow, Role, Record
relations: App -> Form: contains | Form -> Field: has | Form -> Workflow: triggers | Role -> App: accesses
components: Builder, Workflow, RBAC, Data store, Deploy

name: Test Automation Copilot
tagline: Sinh và chạy test từ requirement, có coverage và triage.
problem: Test coverage thấp; viết test thủ công tốn thời gian; bug lọt ra production.
solution: Parse requirement, generate cases, run, report, triage và coverage.
entities: Requirement, TestCase, Run, Result, Defect, Coverage
relations: Requirement -> TestCase: derives | TestCase -> Run: executed in | Run -> Result: produces | Result -> Defect: may raise
components: Parser, Generator, Runner, Report, Triage

name: Code Review Copilot
tagline: Review PR theo risk, checklist và ngữ cảnh dự án.
problem: Review chậm, thiếu context; reviewer bỏ sót rủi ro và consistency.
solution: Diff analysis, risk scoring, checklist, comment và summary.
entities: PullRequest, Diff, Finding, Rule, Risk, Comment
relations: PullRequest -> Diff: contains | Diff -> Finding: produces | Finding -> Rule: checked by | Finding -> Risk: scored
components: Diff parser, Analyzer, Rule engine, Commenter, Report

name: Incident Copilot
tagline: Log, alert, runbook và postmortem trong một luồng.
problem: Sự cố hỗn loạn; alert trùng lặp, runbook khó tìm, postmortem viết tay.
solution: Alert ingest, correlation, runbook suggestion, timeline và postmortem.
entities: Incident, Alert, Service, Runbook, Timeline, Action
relations: Alert -> Incident: correlates | Incident -> Service: affects | Runbook -> Incident: guides | Timeline -> Incident: records
components: Alert ingest, Correlation, Runbook, Timeline, Postmortem
